title: KP14 vyg25 with the loadings x2: three types [0.04, 0.14, 0.28], level-compensated, price 2.5
question: Does the positive (interaction-only, monotone-premium) KP14 ladder reach a sizeable gap when its loadings are scaled, as GS21's product did?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30). The user wants an interaction economy with a fair gap of 0.1/yr (+0.029 monthly) in KP14 that is not the hump. The sign-switching ladders cannot be it: their premium is hump-shaped whatever the compensation (vyg25su, bv_comp 0, has vyg25s's returns to the digit). The positive ladder vyg25 (0.02/0.07/0.14) has a monotone premium (0.85/0.81/0.75 %/mo) and a gap of +0.015; its size was never varied. GS21's product ladder rose from +0.02 at 0.05 to +0.08 at 0.075-0.15 before the type became linearly visible.

FEASIBILITY: A0 finite at these loadings (vyg25sx2/sx3 used +-0.28 / +-0.42).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-30): room above vyg25's 24%; gap +0.02 to +0.06 at x2, lower at x3 if the type becomes linearly visible. FALSIFIED if the gap is at or below vyg25's +0.015 on three seeds.
